item.title: 15 per cent pay rise for early educators locked in as new legislation passes parliament
item.description: The Australian Parliament has passed legislation extending funding for the 15 per cent wage increase for eligible early childhood education and care workers while introducing stronger safety conditions for participating services.

item.title: Montessori Academy partners with child safety pioneer Holly-ann Martin OAM to empower children to speak up, stay safe and be heard
item.description: Aligned with National Child Protection Week, Montessori Academy is turning conversation into action through a new organisation-wide partnership with Safe4Kids, strengthening protective education for children, educators and families across over 70 early learning services.

item.title: Digital Duty of Care Bill 2026: What early childhood services need to know
item.description: The Australian Government has released an exposure draft of the Online Safety Amendment (Digital Duty of Care) Bill 2026, proposing a new legal framework to place greater responsibility on online service providers to prevent foreseeable harm.

item.title: What NSW’s latest enforcement register can teach the ECEC sector about strengthening safety and compliance
item.description: The NSW Early Learning Commission’s enforcement register for April to June 2026 provides the early childhood education and care sector with an opportunity to reflect on the systems that support children’s safety, wellbeing and participation.
